Only one concrete implementation exists: an unexported `service` struct in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`.

NewAPIV1Service constructs the service and passes it to RSSService. memopayload.Runner holds the interface, but it is never instantiated in production; callers supply the service directly. Test mocks may implement the interface.

Checking whether test or benchmark files create separate instances. The runtime path is being traced.

The concrete implementation is an unexported `*service` created by `markdown.NewService` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`.

`NewAPIV1Service` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` constructs the runtime instance with tag and mention extensions. It passes that same instance to `RSSService` in `server/server.go`.

`APIV1Service` holds the interface via its `MarkdownService` field. `RSSService` holds it as well.

Tests instantiate their own via `markdown.NewService` in `test_helper`.

`memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` accepts `markdown.Service` as a function parameter rather than holding it in a struct field. `memooad.Runner` declares a `MarkdownService` field, but `NewRunner` is never invoked in production, so it does not hold a constructed instance at runtime. `fileserver` does not retain the interface in production either.

It is constructed by `markdown.NewService` with extensions passed from `NewAPIV1Service` in `v1.go` (lines 48–51), which is wired from `server.NewServer` in `server.go` (line 76). **impl:** unexported `*service` (goldmark-backed) — `internal/markdown/markdown.go`  
**construction:** `markdown.NewService(markdown.WithTagExtension(), markdown.WithMentionExtension())` in `NewAPIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51`), called from `server.NewServer` (`server/server.go:76`)  
**holders:** `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`); `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`), injected with the same instance at `server/server.go:85`

There is a single concrete implementation. The interface is `markdown.Service` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:31-55`); the only implementation is the unexported `service` struct (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:57-60`), returned by `NewService` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:85-112`).

At runtime, one instance is built in `NewAPIV1Service` with tag and mention extensions enabled. That same instance is passed into `RSSService` during server startup (`server/server.go:85`). No other production code constructs a different implementation; `memopayload.NewRunner` (which also accepts `markdown.Service`) is never called outside its definition file, so `memopayload.Runner` does not hold a live instance in production—only `RebuildMemoPayload(..., markdownService)` receives the interface as a parameter from `APIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`).

Tests construct additional `markdown.NewService(...)` instances (e.g. `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`), but those are test-only.
